column1: # Gate row needs: <row key><TAB><key>[; <key>...]. Under CI_TIER=rows a listed
# row also runs every row it needs (transitively): the build rows whose image it
# boots or inspects. tools/ci_check.sh expands CI_ROWS with this closure
# to be a label the gate prints. A row that boots a kernel its own prep or a
# top-level kbuild makes needs no line: those builds run on demand.
